title: Introduction
quote:
I love this world,
I wish to keep programming my whole life as I have until now,
with the utmost enthusiasm and dedication.
paragraphs: I remember my first day at school when I had signed up for something called "programming". I was as curious as I was scared since I knew nothing about the subject, only that I was good at "computer stuff". Today that fear has turned into confidence and my greatest strength.

I started with Java developing for Android and although I enjoyed it, I decided to take a web course. That is when I saw the potential that web development offers: its simplicity and flexibility. I realised that most projects could be built with that technology and I found it exciting — I had found the branch I loved!

I have worked as a back-end and front-end developer, with the latter being my favourite as it is closer to the user. I am passionate about how things work, somewhat obsessed with user experience and I find satisfaction in seeing the final result.
That is all from me for now. I would like to continue growing personally and professionally at a great company. If you are as enthusiastic as I am about this world, do not hesitate to get in touch!
